title: The gate classifier gives the push class to a kb-content gate that only names a forge, its host name or the product Remote Control
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons classes a gate on an item whose touches all lie under kb/ (none in the query log store) by what it decides, not push, when its only push words name a vendor or product: a forge's name or host name (GitLab, GitHub, gitlab.com, github.com, gitlab-org/gitlab in a source url or a licence note, GitLab's MCP server), the product name Remote Control, or a key name inside a longer word (datePublished); a gate that asks to push, publish, force-push, deploy or upload, names a git remote, origin, a mirror, a release or a remote ref (gitlab/main), or whose item touches a push path or any file outside kb/, stays push.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;it={'id':'BG-x','kind':'bug','touches':['kb/public/agents/doc-lookup-sources.md']};g={'id':'g1','question':"Does GitLab's GA MCP server get a row in doc-lookup-sources.csv, or does the article state why it is left out?",'options':['reason: no row','row: add a ranked row'],'recommendation':'reason: no row'};c=a.gate_class(it,g);print(c);sys.exit(1 if c=='push' else 0)

import bl_authority as a
item=dict(touches=['kb/public/claude/cross-session-messaging.md'])
g=dict(id='g3',question='Where does the Projects github.com caveat go in the DER of the article?',options=['a sentence inside the existing DER','a separate DER line after it'])
pin=dict(id='g1',question='Which form pins the source row S-vt5s6nsz?',options=['public projection hash on github.com','private hash on gitlab.com'])

sys.exit(0 if c[0]!='push' and c[1]!='push' and c[2]=='push' else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as a
kb = {'touches': ['kb/public/gitlab/x.md']}
def c(q, it=kb, opts=('one', 'two')):
    return a.derived_class(it, {'id': 'g1', 'question': q, 'options': list(opts)})
r = dict(push=c('Push the branch to github.com now?'),
         publish=c('Publish the kb to the public repository?'),
         ref=c('Should land reset to gitlab/main?'),
         remote=c('Which git remote does the sync use?', opts=('origin', 'a mirror')),
         release=c('How is the Sonnet 5.5 release question dispositioned?'),
         gate_path=c('Which GitLab project hosts the CI?', it={'touches': ['_tools/kbgit.py']}),
         mixed=c('Which GitLab doc row stays?', it={'touches': ['kb/public/gitlab/x.md', '_tools/fetch.py']}))
print(r)
sys.exit(0 if set(r.values()) == {'push'} else 1)

gates.question: Which words stop classing a kb-content gate as a push gate?
options: vendor names only: forge names and host names, the product Remote Control and a key inside a longer word; release, tag and the push verbs keep the class
vendor names, and release and tag when they name an upstream package a fact is pinned to
none: keep every word and answer such gates by hand
gates.recommendation: vendor names only: forge names and host names, the product Remote Control and a key inside a longer word; release, tag and the push verbs keep the class
gates.answer: vendor names only: forge names and host names, the product Remote Control and a key inside a longer word; release, tag and the push verbs keep the class
gates.host_unchecked: the gate decides which words the classifier skips; 'host name' names a forge's domain, no host setup to prove

gates.question: Which identifier shapes with Publish inside count as a key name in a kb-content gate?
options: camelCase and snake_case identifiers only (datePublished, date_published); a bare publish or published stays push
any word that holds publish inside a longer word
gates.recommendation: camelCase and snake_case identifiers only (datePublished, date_published); a bare publish or published stays push
gates.answer: camelCase and snake_case identifiers only (datePublished, date_published); a bare publish or published stays push
